scope: Current bounded cell review of Type 0 root fonts (Table 119), embedded Encoding CMap stream dictionaries (Table 118), and related predefined CMap references. It does not re-audit complete CMap syntax, ToUnicode destination algorithms, CIDFont cells, font program conformance, or all Type 0 malformed-input behavior.

source_locations.section_9_7_3_and_issue_518: Physical p.344 / printed p.329. Issue #518 StrikeOut applies to the CMap-side CIDSystemInfo description; its effective form no longer allows an array of CMap CIDSystemInfo dictionaries. Keep this CMap-side correction separate from Table 115's required CIDFont-side dictionary.
source_locations.table_116: Physical pp.350–352 / printed pp.335–337; footer checked. The table lists predefined CMap names and descriptions, including Identity-H and Identity-V.
source_locations.table_117: Physical p.353 / printed p.338. The table is intentionally empty to preserve its number; version/collection data is in normative references, so it adds no cells to test.
source_locations.table_118: Physical pp.353–354 / printed pp.338–339. Table 118 begins on p.353 and continues on p.354.

Issue #324 StrikeOut/Caret on this page changes the ToUnicode cross-reference to §9.10; it does not change ToUnicode's optional/stream type. #278 at physical p.353 / printed p.338 strikes stray punctuation in §9.7.5.2, not a CMap requirement.

table_119_type0_cells.assertions: All deterministic Type0 fixtures use /Type /Font. This review did not assert malformed-Type refusal as an ISO reader obligation.

table_119_type0_cells.code: opening.rs::load_composite is entered after the font loader identifies the Type0 route.
table_119_type0_cells.assertions: Named Type0 fixtures assert embedded/predefined CMap behavior through LoadedFont and public page interpretation.

table_119_type0_cells.source_rule: Required name. The suggested descendant/CMap concatenation for a Type0 CIDFont and same-name rule for a Type2 CIDFont are SHOULD conventions; the table explicitly notes the name is arbitrary in principle because no program is associated directly with the root Type0 dictionary.
table_119_type0_cells.code: The ordinary reader uses the descendant descriptor/program for selection; archive writer materializes the conventional spelling in its own path.
table_119_type0_cells.assertions: Tests generally use /LiberationSans or fixture names and do not require a particular mismatch error. Ledger correctly says the root name is not the program identity.
table_119_type0_cells.assessment: do not promote SHOULD or identity hint into a reader failure claim

table_119_type0_cells.source_rule: Required name or stream: predefined CMap name or stream defining code-to-font-number/CID mapping. For Type2 CIDFonts whose associated TrueType program is not embedded, the producer shall use a predefined CMap name.
table_119_type0_cells.code: pdf-font/src/composite.rs::composite_cmap resolves Identity names, carried predefined names, or an embedded stream; loading/opening.rs::load_composite builds glyph selection from the result.
table_119_type0_cells.assertions: composite_font_fixtures.rs::a_predefined_cmap_named_by_the_type_0_font_is_resolved has literal 90ms-RKSJ-H one-/two-byte CID answers; ::an_embedded_cmap_with_one_byte_ranges_makes_one_byte_one_code and ::a_codespace_of_several_lengths_splits_a_string_where_its_ranges_say exercise valid stream forms. `text_state_vertical_spec_audit.rs` is a valid embedded Type2 public-page fixture with matching stream and data WMode=1. The nonembedded-Type2/custom-stream restriction is a producer condition; current reader tolerance is not called a defect.
table_119_type0_cells.assessment: both allowed Encodings have discriminating evidence; one valid Encoding stream inheritance route remains a coverage gap below

table_119_type0_cells.source_rule: Required one-element array naming the descendant CIDFont.
table_119_type0_cells.code: opening.rs::load_composite resolves its first item; errors if no dictionary is selected.
table_119_type0_cells.assertions: Valid fixtures use one CIDFont descendant. `silent_fonts.rs` tests null/no selected descendant as a reported malformed dictionary; this is distinct from valid consumer coverage.
table_119_type0_cells.assessment: valid exact-one shape is common and exercised; no new invalid cardinality claim

table_119_type0_cells.source_rule: Optional stream mapping character codes to Unicode; #324 corrects the Table 119 cross-reference to §9.10.
table_119_type0_cells.code: composite.rs::to_unicode and loading codes/readback consume it when present; absence continues to collection/name methods when available.
table_119_type0_cells.assertions: Current ToUnicode CMap shard owns the valid inheritance case and the B27/B28 findings for source-code length/multi-scalar sequential destination behavior. Those results are not duplicated here. Type0 rendering fixtures also operate without ToUnicode.
table_119_type0_cells.assessment: optional presence/absence is represented; extraction-algorithm gaps are out of this shard

table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.code: composite.rs::read_cmap reads decoded stream bytes and does not independently validate this dictionary entry.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.assertions: All valid custom CMap fixtures state /Type /CMap.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.assessment: valid premise represented; invalid type tolerance is not a reader defect

table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.source_rule: Required name; shall match CMapName in the CMap file.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.code: The parser reads mappings/WMode from stream data; this metadata match is not needed to compute the mapping.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.assertions: Deterministic Encoding fixtures use identical dictionary and CMap-file names.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.assessment: source producer constraint; no mismatch-rejection requirement inferred

table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.source_rule: Required dictionary, same as the value in the CMap file; it does not need to match Identity-H/Identity-V's values. After #518, the CMap file's own CIDSystemInfo shape is a single dictionary. Its Registry/Ordering compatibility with the descendant is separately described by §9.7.3.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.code: The Encoding CMap consumer reads mapping and WMode; collection and substitution semantics use the descendant CIDFont's collection through composite.rs, not a comparison of these two metadata copies.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.assertions: CMap fixtures state matching dictionaries and file metadata. #518's former array allowance and Table 115 descendant dictionary are treated separately.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.assessment: matching valid representations exercised; inconsistent duplicate metadata is invalid producer input, not a mandatory refusal claim

table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.source_rule: Optional integer: 0 horizontal, 1 vertical, default 0; if present its value shall equal the CMap file's WMode.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.code: CMap::parse reads file WMode, defaulting horizontal; composite_cmap checks dictionary/data agreement and uses the mode to select horizontal vs vertical metrics.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.assertions: Valid vertical stream/page test `text_state_vertical_spec_audit.rs` states WMode 1 in both locations and asserts vertical glyph placement, TJ and scaling. Horizontal custom CMaps default both to 0 in composite_font_fixtures. ADR 0045 retains an explicit refusal for mismatched duplicate WMode values; mismatch is malformed producer output, not a PDF reader defect finding.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.assessment: valid horizontal/default and vertical path evidenced; no new test needed

table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.source_rule: Optional predefined name or CMap stream. If present, the referencing map states only mappings that differ from the referenced map. Under §9.7.5.4(a), an in-file usecmap reference must also be identified by this dictionary entry.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.code: composite.rs::read_cmap resolves a predefined name or referenced stream, parses local mappings over the base, and requires an in-file reference to have the dictionary base available. cmap.rs unit test `a_referencing_cmap_inherits_and_overrides` checks local override and inherited codespace, but bypasses PDF objects.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.assertions: Public stream-valued UseCMap tests currently belong to the ToUnicode parser path (Table 125a), not the Encoding CMap path. The Encoding CMap parser unit test is not a Type0/pdf-model page consumer, and the corpus contains no Encoding CMap usecmap chain per composite.rs comment.
table_118_cmap_stream_dictionary_cells.assessment: specific valid public consumer gap; draft is supplied

predefined_and_owner_evidence.table_116_support: §9.7.5.2 states processors shall support Adobe-CNS1-7, Adobe-GB1-5, Adobe-Japan1-7, and Adobe-KR-9. ADR 0140 carries the 239 published Adobe CMaps (including chains) and current predefined.rs assertions check required collections, carried files/codespace/mappings, vertical pairs, and chain bounds. The fixed Type0 fixture checks the actual RKSJ-H name-to-CID mapping; a corpus test is optional and may skip for host-font availability.
predefined_and_owner_evidence.table_117: Intentionally empty, not a missing table obligation. Do not infer missing version support from absence of rows; Table 116 and current normative references own the relevant collection data.

public_consumer_gap: An exact-xref valid embedded Type0 PDF whose Encoding CMap stream uses Table 118 /UseCMap to inherit a second CMap stream has no located public page assertion. Existing CMap::parse unit test covers the mapping rule but not dictionary object resolution, Table 118 metadata, font loading, and glyph selection together. A bounded draft distinguishes base-only CID 36 from child-local CID 37 using LiberationSans glyphs and exact expected GIDs. No behavior failure is established.
residuals: No exhaustive Table119 malformed/indirect-value matrix; no reader-duty claim for producer-invalid duplicate metadata.
No exhaustive Table116 collection/version/CMap matrix beyond ADR0140's carried corpus and its tests.
No PDF Encoding-CMap test for a stream-valued UseCMap base; draft is unrun.
ToUnicode mapping defects B27/B28 and its separate Table125a UseCMap coverage are tracked in other shards.
